title: Damngal ngal Taƴi Laamu
intro: Leydi maayooji ɓuuɓɗi, gese ɗiɗi ɓutte, e jawdi ndi alaa ɗo haaɗi — kono hoɗɓe mum ɓeydiima waasde faamde barkinoowo ɓe. Nde siftorde ari noddirde ɓe ngarta, ɓe njirloyii. Ko rewi heen ko jukkungo ngo haa jooni ina jokki e jeertinaango. Hol ko wonnoo ndee renndo ɓooyngo?
clues: Min nguuri ko e leydi barkinndi haa galle amen woni hakkunde gese ɗiɗi ɓutte.
Min mbeltiima e maayooji ɓuuɓɗi e nder leyɗeele amen e geɗe keewɗe ɗe min kebbini galleeji amen.
Kono nde min noddaa ngam yettude e ɗooftaade Joomiraacfo amen, min mbayliima e mawnikinaare.
Ngalu men e weeɓde men mbaɗti en yejjiteede e dokkuɗo ɗum fof.
Ndeen arii ɓuuɓol ɓuuɓngol, ɓuuɓol mawngol ngol min tuugninoo ngol.
Minen ko min leñol Saba'en, leydi mumen anndanoondi baraas Ma'rib mawɗo oo.

outcome.label: Hoddiro men
options: Jardiiji ɗiɗi ɓuuɓɗi lomtii ɗi men ɓuuɓɗi ɗii
Min mberlaama e nder cumu ɓuuɓngu
Leñol men feccii e leƴƴi sappo e ɗiɗi
outcome.answer: Jardiiji ɗiɗi ɓuuɓɗi lomtii ɗi men ɓuuɓɗi ɗii

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
